record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: If 0 < p < 2 and F belongs to the Hardy space H^p of Dirichlet series, is F locally in the Nevanlinna class?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.4. Are elements of Hp for p < 2 locally in the Nevanlinna class?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{C}_\theta := \{s \in \mathbb{C} : \mathrm{Re}\, s > \theta\}$ denote the half-plane with abscissa $\theta$. For $0 < p < \infty$, the Hardy space $\mathcal{H}^p$ of Dirichlet series is defined as the completion of the space of Dirichlet polynomials $P(s) = \sum_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s}$ under the norm
$$\|P\|_{\mathcal{H}^p} := \left(\lim_{T\to\infty} \frac{1}{2T}\int_{-T}^{T} |P(it)|^p\, dt\right)^{1/p}.$$
Every $F \in \mathcal{H}^p$ converges and defines a holomorphic function on the half-plane $\mathbb{C}_{1/2}$.

A holomorphic function $f$ on a half-plane $\mathbb{C}_\sigma$ is said to belong to the Nevanlinna class on $\mathbb{C}_\sigma$ if
$$\sup_{\sigma' > \sigma} \int_{\mathbb{R}} \log^+ |f(\sigma' + it)|\, d\mu(t) < \infty$$
for a suitable Poisson-type measure $\mu$ (equivalently, $\log^+|f|$ has a harmonic majorant on $\mathbb{C}_\sigma$). One says that $F$ is locally in the Nevanlinna class if for every $\sigma > 1/2$ the restriction of $F$ to $\mathbb{C}_\sigma$ belongs to the Nevanlinna class on $\mathbb{C}_\sigma$.

Question: Suppose $0 < p < 2$ and $F \in \mathcal{H}^p$. Is $F$ necessarily locally in the Nevanlinna class?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not surface a published proof or counterexample answering whether elements of $\mathcal{H}^p$ for $p<2$ are locally in the Nevanlinna class. The problem appears in lists of open problems on analysis of Dirichlet series, and related work (e.g., on Nevanlinna and Smirnov classes for Dirichlet series and on mean counting functions) addresses adjacent questions but does not seem to resolve this one. Status remains unclear from accessible sources.

status_evidence.title: Hardy spaces of general Dirichlet series – a survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series including discussion of Nevanlinna-type classes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys discuss Hardy and Nevanlinna-type spaces of Dirichlet series without resolving the local Nevanlinna question for p<2.

status_evidence.title: A mean counting function for Dirichlet series and compact composition operators
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces a mean counting function playing the role of the Nevanlinna counting function for Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series.
status_evidence.claim: Related developments on Nevanlinna-type tools for Dirichlet series have appeared, but do not directly settle the stated problem.
